notes: All methods share exact per-model detection cache.
No GT boxes or IDs enter inference or tracker updates; new targets detected every frame.
IR evaluated against IR GT; RGB and RGBT against RGB GT.
BoT-SORT has no appearance ReID; not a full ReID-enabled baseline.
Track buffer 90 at frame_rate10 corresponds to 30 lost frames for ByteTrack/BoT-SORT.
Directory split protocol; Drone1 IR COCO conflict retained.
Three snapshots can represent different training epochs; intermediate results are not final comparisons.
Deep OC-SORT and ImprAssoc use shared CLIP-VeRi embeddings with appearance enabled.
RGBT embeddings use RGB crops; IR embeddings use IR images as three channels.
This is pooled-drone detector training, not the paper separate-training protocol.
DeepSORT confidence>0.5; StrongSORT confidence>=0.6. Both consume verified parent high-confidence embeddings.
DeepSORT official output includes one predicted frame after a miss; StrongSORT outputs confirmed tracks updated this frame.
Shared detector and CLIP-VeRi control protocol; not original published detector/ReID configurations.
reporting: Drone 1 and Drone 2 separately; pooled aggregation supplementary

reid.name: CLIP-ReID ViT-B/16 VeRi
reid.training_domain: VeRi visible-light vehicles; not adapted to M3OT aerial/IR
reid.rgbt_embedding_reference: RGB crop from fused detector box; not cross-modal ReID fusion

changes: Isolated namespace and lazy root init
Use existing v16 ReID loader with .model interface
Initialize feature deque/EMA alpha before first feature update (upstream crashes for nonempty features)
Mask precomputed embeddings by exact high detection mask (upstream assumes prefiltered inputs)
imprassoc.algorithm: Original combined matching, combined distance and occlusion-aware initialization retained

deepsort.source_modifications: None; pure package copied under isolated import name. Output bookkeeping is implemented in a separate adapter.

implementation.strongsort: BoxMOT16.0.11 online StrongSORT, ECC; no AFLink/GSI
